answers.question: What is the connection between SSA phi functions and the AST-to-three-address-code discussion in this course?
answers.text: Based on the provided material, there is no direct connection described between SSA phi functions and the AST-to-three-address-code conversion; they are discussed as separate topics within Lecture 1 [L1 T0:12–3:17; L1 T6:46–9:59]. The lecture covers SSA node convergence regarding where to place phi functions [L1 T0:12–3:17] and the strategy for converting AST expressions into three-address code by using virtual registers [L1 T6:46–9:59].

answers.question: What did the lecturer say about virtual registers, and where in the lecture can I find it?
answers.text: In Lecture 1, the lecturer states that virtual registers are assumed to be infinite, meaning you can create a new register for every new value [L1 T9:13]. This allows you to not worry about whether there are enough registers available [L1 T9:13].
